---
title: "Warfarin NCA and Initial Theta estimation"
author: "Yizhen Lai"
date: "2026-06-16"
output: word_document
---

############################################################
# Warfarin PKNCA workflow
# Full workflow:
# 1. Load warfarin data
# 2. Extract PK concentration data
# 3. Add predose concentration at time 0
# 4. Handle duplicate concentration records
# 5. Run individual-level NCA with PKNCA
# 6. Create individual NCA table
# 7. Create NCA summary statistics
# 8. Derive initial theta values for nlmixr2
############################################################

############################################################
# 0. Package setup
############################################################

```{r}
options(timeout = 1000)
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

pkgs <- c(
  "nlmixr2data",
  "PKNCA",
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "tibble"
)

new_pkgs <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]

if (length(new_pkgs) > 0) {
  install.packages(new_pkgs, dependencies = TRUE, type = "binary")
}

library(nlmixr2data)
library(PKNCA)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)

get_output_dir <- function() {
  input_file <- tryCatch(
    knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
    error = function(e) character(0)
  )
  
  if (length(input_file) > 0 && nzchar(input_file[1])) {
    input_file <- input_file[1]
    return(dirname(normalizePath(input_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)))
  }
  
  getwd()
}

output_dir <- get_output_dir()

############################################################
# 1. Load warfarin data
############################################################

data("warfarin", package = "nlmixr2data")

wf <- warfarin %>%
  mutate(
    id   = as.character(id),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    amt  = as.numeric(amt),
    dv   = as.numeric(dv),
    evid = as.numeric(evid),
    dvid = as.character(dvid)
  )

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Data overview\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(dim(wf))
print(table(wf$dvid, useNA = "ifany"))

############################################################
# 2. Keep PK concentration part only
# dvid == "cp": PK concentration
# dvid == "pca": PD response
############################################################

pk_data <- wf %>%
  filter(dvid == "cp")

############################################################
# 3. Prepare dose data
############################################################

dose_data <- pk_data %>%
  filter(evid != 0, !is.na(amt), amt > 0) %>%
  transmute(
    id = id,
    time = time,
    dose = amt
  )

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Dose data\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("Number of dose records:", nrow(dose_data), "\n")
print(as_tibble(head(dose_data, 10)))

write.csv(
  dose_data,
  file.path(output_dir, "01_dose_for_pknca.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 4. Prepare observed concentration data
############################################################

conc_obs <- pk_data %>%
  filter(evid == 0, !is.na(dv), dv >= 0) %>%
  transmute(
    id = id,
    time = time,
    conc = dv
  )

############################################################
# 5. Add predose concentration
# For single oral dose NCA, add time = 0, conc = 0
# This allows PKNCA to calculate AUC from 0 to last / infinity.
############################################################

conc_time0 <- dose_data %>%
  transmute(
    id = id,
    time = 0,
    conc = 0
  )

conc_data_raw <- bind_rows(
  conc_time0,
  conc_obs
) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(id), time)

############################################################
# 6. Check duplicate concentration records
############################################################

dup_conc <- conc_data_raw %>%
  count(id, time) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Duplicate concentration time points\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(as_tibble(dup_conc), n = Inf)

dup_conc_detail <- conc_data_raw %>%
  semi_join(dup_conc, by = c("id", "time")) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(id), time)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Duplicate concentration details\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(as_tibble(dup_conc_detail), n = Inf)

write.csv(
  dup_conc_detail,
  file.path(output_dir, "02_duplicate_concentration_records.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 7. Handle duplicates for NCA
# Same id + same time: use mean concentration
############################################################

conc_data_clean <- conc_data_raw %>%
  group_by(id, time) %>%
  summarise(
    conc = mean(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_original = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Concentration records after duplicate handling\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(
  as_tibble(
    conc_data_clean %>%
      filter(n_original > 1) %>%
      arrange(as.numeric(id), time)
  ),
  n = Inf
)

conc_data_pknca <- conc_data_clean %>%
  select(id, time, conc)

cat("\nNumber of concentration records used for NCA:", nrow(conc_data_pknca), "\n")

write.csv(
  conc_data_pknca,
  file.path(output_dir, "03_concentration_for_pknca.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 8. Create PKNCA objects
############################################################

conc_obj <- PKNCAconc(
  conc ~ time | id,
  data = conc_data_pknca
)

dose_obj <- PKNCAdose(
  dose ~ time | id,
  data = dose_data
)

############################################################
# 9. Define NCA intervals
############################################################

intervals <- data.frame(
  start = 0,
  end = Inf,
  auclast = TRUE,
  aucinf.obs = TRUE,
  cmax = TRUE,
  tmax = TRUE,
  half.life = TRUE,
  cl.obs = TRUE,
  vz.obs = TRUE
)

############################################################
# 10. Run individual-level NCA
############################################################

nca_obj <- PKNCAdata(
  conc_obj,
  dose_obj,
  intervals = intervals
)

nca_result <- pk.nca(nca_obj)

nca_df <- as.data.frame(nca_result)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Raw PKNCA result\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(as_tibble(nca_df), n = Inf)

write.csv(
  nca_df,
  file.path(output_dir, "04_pknca_result_long_raw.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 11. Clean PKNCA output
############################################################

nca_long <- nca_df %>%
  transmute(
    id = as.character(id),
    parameter = tolower(as.character(PPTESTCD)),
    value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(PPORRES))),
    exclude = exclude
  )

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Excluded NCA results, if any\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(
  as_tibble(
    nca_long %>%
      filter(!is.na(exclude))
  ),
  n = Inf
)

nca_long_clean <- nca_long %>%
  filter(is.na(exclude), !is.na(value))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Clean long-format NCA result\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(as_tibble(nca_long_clean), n = Inf)

write.csv(
  nca_long_clean,
  file.path(output_dir, "05_pknca_result_long_clean.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 12. Create individual NCA table
############################################################

wanted_params <- c(
  "auclast",
  "aucinf.obs",
  "cmax",
  "tmax",
  "half.life",
  "cl.obs",
  "vz.obs"
)

nca_individual <- nca_long_clean %>%
  filter(parameter %in% wanted_params) %>%
  distinct(id, parameter, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(id, parameter, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = parameter,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(id))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Individual NCA table\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(as_tibble(nca_individual), n = Inf)

write.csv(
  nca_individual,
  file.path(output_dir, "06_pknca_individual_table.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 13. NCA summary statistics
############################################################

geo_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !is.na(x) & x > 0]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  exp(mean(log(x)))
}

geo_cv_percent <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x) & !is.na(x) & x > 0]
  if (length(x) <= 1) return(NA_real_)
  100 * sqrt(exp(sd(log(x))^2) - 1)
}

nca_stat <- nca_long_clean %>%
  filter(parameter %in% wanted_params) %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv_percent = 100 * sd / mean,
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    geometric_mean = geo_mean(value),
    geometric_cv_percent = geo_cv_percent(value),
    min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(parameter, wanted_params))

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("NCA summary statistics\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(as_tibble(nca_stat), n = Inf)

write.csv(
  nca_stat,
  file.path(output_dir, "07_pknca_summary_statistics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 14. Derive initial theta values for nlmixr2
############################################################

cl_init <- nca_stat %>%
  filter(parameter == "cl.obs") %>%
  pull(geometric_mean)

v_init <- nca_stat %>%
  filter(parameter == "vz.obs") %>%
  pull(geometric_mean)

tmax_median <- nca_stat %>%
  filter(parameter == "tmax") %>%
  pull(median)

# Fallbacks
if (length(cl_init) == 0 || is.na(cl_init) || !is.finite(cl_init)) {
  cl_init <- nca_stat %>%
    filter(parameter == "cl.obs") %>%
    pull(median)
}

if (length(v_init) == 0 || is.na(v_init) || !is.finite(v_init)) {
  v_init <- nca_stat %>%
    filter(parameter == "vz.obs") %>%
    pull(median)
}

if (length(tmax_median) == 0 || is.na(tmax_median) || !is.finite(tmax_median)) {
  tmax_median <- 1
}

############################################################
# 15. Estimate rough Ka initial value
# Ka is not directly estimated by NCA.
# This only provides a rough initial value for nlmixr2.
############################################################

estimate_ka_from_tmax <- function(tmax, k) {
  if (
    length(tmax) == 0 || length(k) == 0 ||
    is.na(tmax) || is.na(k) ||
    !is.finite(tmax) || !is.finite(k) ||
    tmax <= 0 || k <= 0
  ) {
    return(1)
  }
  
  f <- function(ka) {
    log(ka / k) / (ka - k) - tmax
  }
  
  out <- tryCatch(
    uniroot(
      f,
      lower = k * 1.001,
      upper = 100
    )$root,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  
  if (!is.finite(out) || is.na(out)) {
    return(1)
  }
  
  out
}

k_init <- cl_init / v_init

ka_init <- estimate_ka_from_tmax(
  tmax = tmax_median,
  k = k_init
)

# Safety fallback
if (!is.finite(ka_init) || is.na(ka_init) || ka_init <= 0 || ka_init > 10) {
  ka_init <- 1
}

############################################################
# 16. Final theta table
############################################################

theta_init <- tibble(
  parameter = c(
    "theta_KA",
    "theta_CLF",
    "theta_VZF",
    "log_theta_KA",
    "log_theta_CLF",
    "log_theta_VZF"
  ),
  source = c(
    "Tmax-based rough estimate; not direct NCA parameter",
    "NCA geometric mean of CL/F",
    "NCA geometric mean of Vz/F",
    "log(theta_KA)",
    "log(theta_CLF)",
    "log(theta_VZF)"
  ),
  value = c(
    ka_init,
    cl_init,
    v_init,
    log(ka_init),
    log(cl_init),
    log(v_init)
  )
)

cat("\n==============================\n")
cat("Initial theta values for nlmixr2\n")
cat("==============================\n")
print(as_tibble(theta_init), n = Inf)

write.csv(
  theta_init,
  file.path(output_dir, "08_theta_initial_values_from_nca.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

############################################################
# 17. Print ini() values for nlmixr2
############################################################

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Use these values in nlmixr2 ini():\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("tka <- log(", signif(ka_init, 5), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("tcl <- log(", signif(cl_init, 5), ")\n", sep = "")
cat("tv  <- log(", signif(v_init, 5), ")\n", sep = "")

cat("\nRecommended initial random effects and residual error:\n\n")
cat("eta.ka ~ 0.1\n")
cat("eta.cl ~ 0.1\n")
cat("eta.v  ~ 0.1\n")
cat("prop.err <- 0.2\n")

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Done. Files saved in current working directory:\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("01_dose_for_pknca.csv\n")
cat("02_duplicate_concentration_records.csv\n")
cat("03_concentration_for_pknca.csv\n")
cat("04_pknca_result_long_raw.csv\n")
cat("05_pknca_result_long_clean.csv\n")
cat("06_pknca_individual_table.csv\n")
cat("07_pknca_summary_statistics.csv\n")
cat("08_theta_initial_values_from_nca.csv\n")
```
